shape.appetite: Three independently shippable releases: (1) selection, region values, import; (2) one country set and content controls; (3) street context. No new runtime dependency before release 3; at most one in it.
shape.problem: Point and region maps have suspected selection faults, thin import and join diagnostics, no ready country geometry, no control over visible content, and no street context for local dashboards.
shape.recommended_shape: Harden the existing D3/SVG maps, add one audited country set and a compact content-controls popover with a nonselectable reference-boundary layer, then add host-supplied street context, preferring raster tiles drawn beneath the existing SVG in Web Mercator over a second rendering engine.

success_moves.move: Add a dependency-light street candidate: raster tiles beneath the existing SVG with a Web Mercator projection (d3-tile, BSD-3, no dependencies).
success_moves.risk_reduced: Avoids a second interaction, accessibility, trace, and facet model; sidesteps React Leaflet v5's React 19 requirement.
success_moves.evidence: Research compared only Leaflet and MapLibre; npm d3-tile 1.0.0 checked 2026-10-11.

success_moves.move: Run the street spike early against owned local tile fixtures, in parallel with release 1.
success_moves.risk_reduced: The renderer decision changes the most downstream work; local fixtures remove provider terms and network from the loop.
success_moves.evidence: Proof plan P06 recommends owned local raster fixtures.

success_moves.move: Reproduce the empty-space clear and draft-Escape faults as failing tests before other map work.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Confirms or retires the suspected baseline defects before features build on them.
success_moves.evidence: PointMap.tsx:211-213 calls updateChart on Escape without the onSettingsChange guard RegionMap.tsx:170 uses.

success_moves.move: Ship no default tile provider; hosts opt in with a preset that includes attribution. Missing preset or tile failure falls back to the plain background.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Separates provider terms, credentials, and export rights from product behavior; gives a clean disable path.
success_moves.evidence: OSMF tile policy and research P07.

success_moves.move: Copy the chosen country geometry into the analysis as a shared geometry asset, prepared by a repeatable script and lazy-loaded.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Reuses the existing save path; offline reopen works; catalog updates never change saved maps.
success_moves.evidence: SavedDataStructure geometryAssets; World Bank demo uses alpha-3 codes which World Atlas numeric IDs do not match.

first_proof.question: Can street context sit beneath the existing SVG maps without a second rendering engine?
first_proof.artifact: Spike on the service-district demo: owned local raster tile fixtures drawn beneath the existing SVG with a Web Mercator projection, checked at 1280, 783, and 390 px and in four facets. Observe point-to-street alignment, pan and zoom feel, unchanged click/Escape/Alt-click/keyboard/save-restore, and added bundle bytes.
first_proof.decision_rule: Pass: candidate A is the street path and Leaflet/MapLibre drop out. Fail: run the same fixtures through Leaflet core before considering MapLibre.

rabbit_holes: Saved view zoom multiplies a fitted world projection; tile zoom is a different quantity. Web Mercator view must be tagged, not reinterpreted.
Country set source: World Atlas (archived, Natural Earth 4.1, numeric IDs) versus Natural Earth 5.1.1 (alpha-3, larger). Audit against World Bank demo codes.
Import retention when a draft closes unsaved.
Provider terms, attribution at narrow widths, and image export rights.
Pan smoothness of re-rendered SVG over tiles at street zoom.
open_decisions: Keep imported boundaries in the shared library when a draft closes unsaved (recommended) or discard them.
Demo street context: live OpenStreetMap tiles under light interactive use, or local fixtures only until a provider is chosen.
